messages:
sara liu: Quick async status check on the HarborHealth private rollout — we're ~48h out from the canary. Need final confirmations on egress fallback, cert delivery, and air-gap artifact sync. Tagging owners: @jamal, @priya, @elena, @mike.

jamal bhatt: I'm owning runtime + canary. Images uploaded to s3-mirror (s3://redwood-artifacts/harborhealth/canary/). Waiting on signed manifest from security to kick the artifact sync. Can run the smoke test Wed 04:00 UTC if everything else is green.

priya rao: Networking checks: firewall diff ready, but we need the customer's NAT IPs and whether they prefer SNAT at their edge. Important: their edge node can't reach our artifact registry over TLS (443) because of an inline proxy doing SNI filtering.

netops-team: netops-team here — please paste the customer NAT IPs and the proxy TLS behavior so we can validate routing and egress ACLs.

mike jorn: firewall snippet I'm proposing (example):
```
# allow redwood registry range
-A OUTPUT -d 35.186.12.0/24 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -d 34.120.6.0/24 -j ACCEPT
```
Also, customer side needs SNI passthrough or we will fail artifact TLS handshake.

elena torres: Security update: manifest signing is in progress. We need customer to finish HSM/KMS key rotation (they started yesterday). Until KMS key is available we can't produce the final signed manifest. Pinged their security contact.

jamal bhatt: For the airgap artifact sync we can also provide a tarball + sha256 if rsync isn't allowed. Priya — do they accept rsync or only scp over a bastion?

priya rao: They only allow scp via a bastion host. We'll need a scheduled maintenance window for inbound file push. Proposed Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC (fits their off-hours). Who can take the transfer?

jamal bhatt: I can run the tar + scp transfer during the window. Will also validate sha256 and unpack script.

sara liu: Ownership recap: runtime/canary: @jamal, networking: @priya, security/signing: @elena, customer liaison + PR/CR: @mike. Action items: 1) Jamal upload signed manifest (or tar) 2) Priya schedule and confirm bastion creds 3) Elena confirm KMS path or provide signed manifest 4) Mike verify PR/CR for deployment helm values. I'll track. :clipboard:

mike jorn: PR opened: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pull/4521 — changes to helm values (nodeAffinity + resource limits). @jamal can you review? ETA today.

jamal bhatt: Reviewing now, will push review comments in ~2h.

ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy-canary job queued for harborhealth-canary (estimate start 2026-03-20T04:00:00Z).

priya rao: Customer NATs incoming: 18.202.34.5, 18.202.34.6 — added to firewall draft. Also they require IP allowlist for callback webhooks; need to confirm callback domain and cert pinning expectations.

elena torres: Webhook TLS note: endpoint TLS works but if they require cert pinning to an intermediate cert we may need to update the client bundle. I'll send a spec to their sec team.

jamal bhatt: Smoke test checklist I'll run after canary deploy: 1) token auth 2) model load (small model) 3) inference p99 < 300ms 4) KV cache warm and validate reuse. Will paste results here post-run.

mike jorn: FYI I've got two approvals pending from product for a temporary quota bump — pinged them, should be fast.

sara liu: Thanks — I'll compile these action items into the runbook and post a final preflight note by Wed 02:00 UTC. If we still have blockers after that we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
